description: Bounded Measure mutants for validating analytic feature, distance, transform, assembly, and cube-plane contracts.

mutants.description: Drop the signed normal offset when projecting a point onto a plane.
Translate an edge's endpoint from the already translated start point, collapsing its length.
Normalize the transformed plane point in world coordinates instead of preserving the transformed normal direction.
Discard the circle radius while applying a rigid feature transform.
Prevent a point on a cube edge from selecting its edge feature.
Discard the negative sign for a plane placed below the assembly reference plane.
Stop advertising XYZ distance controls for point-to-point measurements.
